prompt: How many years earlier would Punxsutawney Phil have to be canonically alive to have made a Groundhog Day prediction in the same state as the US capitol?
answer:
**32 years earlier.** The U.S. capital was in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, until 1800. Since Punxsutawney Phil is canonically said to have been born in 1832, he would have needed to be alive by 1800—**32 years earlier**—to make a prediction in the same state as the capital.

(Compared with his first recorded prediction in 1887, that would be 87 years earlier.)
